text:
Nina (Product): Heads up 12 ACME pilot ask: 99.95% SLA, p95 <200ms short prompts, BYOK KMS option, 30d audit retention. They need a realistic launch plan in ~8w. Can teams list blockers and rough ETAs? :eyes:

Renee (Customer Success): ACME will sign if we can demonstrate path to SLA and daily metrics during pilot. POC contact ready.

Omar (Eng-runtime): p95 depends on dedicated pool + warm cache. Estimate ~2w to add tenant prewarm + safe rollout hooks if prioritized. Need perf harness.

Bea (Infra): We can provision dedicated instances (A10G prefer) but need quota and VPC peering tests. ~1w to reserve, ~1w to validate.

Hiro (Security): BYOK KMS is fastest for pilot. Full HSM integration is longer (2-3 sprints). I'll run a short risk review and provide checklist.

Alex (SRE): I'll draft SLIs/alert thresholds and rollback path (auto-fallback to hosted). Need cost cap owner for alerts.

Nina (Product): Proposed MVP: dedicated tenant pool + prewarm, BYOK KMS for pilot, model pin + canary, SLA + runbook + daily reports. Target: 6w if prioritized.

Omar (Eng-runtime): Confirmed. Req: 2 runtime engs, 1 infra eng. Prototype prewarm config Ill use:
```
prewarm: {concurrency:3, kv_seed:24, ttl:600}
```

Bea (Infra): If Product flags pilot-priority, we can meet 6w. Otherwise expect 8-10w.

Hiro (Security): Scheduling risk review for 3 working days from now.

Alex (SRE): Will post runbook stub in 3 days.

Renee (Customer Success): I'll confirm ACME budget cap & daily report format today.

Nina (Product): Action owners: Omar (runtime), Bea (infra), Hiro (security), Alex (SRE), Renee (CS). I'll create the epic now and mark pilot-priority. Sync tomorrow 10:30 PT. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Reminder 12 add epic key to #product when created.
